首触定级(skills 席,session `session_01RMTpSRF5CjMmQBFfPtPCwJ`,2026-08-23 集中定级轮):转 `needs-user-decision` —— 卡自陈「⛔ Which option … is a design call for the maintainer」,词表是协议公开面,超出席位裁量。

**一句话问题**:卡片等的其实是「某个 PR 合了」或「某个版本发了且下游已换上」,但我们的阻塞词表只会写「某张 issue 关了」——于是等待条件被写进散文,机器看不见,该派的不派、不该派的派了。

**选项 × 真实代价**:
- **A. 词表加 PR 形式**(`Blocked-by: <owner/repo>!<pr>`)——做什么:解锁扫描学会认 PR 合并。真实代价:三处读者(解锁扫描/老化告警/巡查)各要多养一个分支,词表每扩一次是永久义务。业务上 = 给调度系统加一种新单据类型。
- **B. 再加 release/pin 形式**——做什么:扫描读消费仓 lockfile。真实代价:最重,发布节奏不稳时(pin-bump 流程还在演进)这个谓词会反复误判;是 objectui#5601 那类事故的直接解法,但为一类事故养一台机器。业务上 = 给调度系统教会读供应链交货单。
- **C. 不扩词表,精确化规则**:等 PR/等发版的卡必须指向一张「在正确时刻关闭」的 issue(pin-bump 杂事卡——协议本就要求立);已有活先例(objectui#5601 → objectui#5716 后正确持住)。真实代价:纪律成本,写错的人还会写错;但巡查 H4/H19 已能抓「没有机器行的 blocked 卡」。业务上 = 不加新单据,要求把每笔等待都换开成已有单据。

**四棱**:
<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 项目长远合理性:C 缩特例(一个名词一个谓词),A/B 扩词表——每个新形式是三处读者的永久增生;
② 实际业务拉动:今天真实撞上的是 objectui#5601 一例(B 类)与 5493 一例(A 类),量级 = 每周个位数,C 的活先例已证明够用;
③ 防 AI 犯错:C 下写错 = 巡查响亮点名(无机器行即红);B 下谓词误判 = 静默错派,错得更贵;
④ 创业阶段不扩散:词表是契约,不为个位数场景扩容;C 零机制变更。
推荐:**C**,回退 **A**(若 C 落地后同类散文阻塞仍反复出现,加 PR 形式一种、⛔ 不加 release 形式)。
本分析看不见的:pin-bump 杂事卡流程自身的稳定性(若它常缺位,C 的前提弱化)。
裁决格式:回一个字母即可;「C,但 X」= 自动按 A 准备。

裁后执行(你不用管):C ⇒ 协议句精确化一行进 SKILL.md/runbook(治理面 PR),巡查已有谓词不动;A ⇒ 另立实现卡进队列。

## Maintainer ruling recorded (atomic four-part write)

Ruled 2026-08-23, live PM chat, verbatim: 「10950 不考虑存量，其他接受你的建议」 — this card falls under the accepted recommendations. **Ruled: C — do not extend the `Blocked-by:` vocabulary.** A card waiting on a PR merge or a release must point at an issue that closes at the right moment (the pin-bump chore card the protocol already requires; live precedent objectui#5601→#5716). Fallback A (PR form only) stays pre-authorized if prose-blocking recurs after C lands — never the release form. `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke (`domain:skills`): per the card's own post-ruling step, one protocol-sentence precision edit into SKILL.md/runbook (governed-face PR, draft + human merge).

## A third instance, measured today — and the sharpest one, because following the field would have parked the card indefinitely

Posted by the `domain:devx` PM seat (session `session_015ahemw8RcTgqtxrj15PEZx`). ⛔ **Information only** — not a claim, no grading, no label change. This card exists to collect instances of the mismatch; here is one, with the reading that makes it worse than the two already recorded.

### The instance

**#11838** (`check-entry-guard.mjs` cannot see a guard inside a template literal) was blocked with:

```
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#6092
Unlock-action: when objectui#6092 closes, requeue and port the landed shape
```

But the block's own stated *rationale*, in the same comment, was:

> the fix shape already exists downstream (objectui PR #6133 …) and its two load-bearing exclusions … were bought with a measured mis-fire. **Porting before that PR lands** risks the same shared-helper diverging in shape across repos.

The precondition is **"PR #6133 merges"**. The field cannot say that, so it said `#6092` — the tracking card that PR is `Part of`.

### Why this instance is worse than a near-miss

objectui#6133 **merged at 20:28:59Z**. objectui#6092 is **still open**, and will stay open for PR 2 of 2 — the conversion of objectui's 29 hand-typed guards to `isEntrypoint`, which touches call sites and **cannot move the `scanSource` shape #11838 ports at all**.

⇒ The dependency was satisfied, and the field said it was not. An unlock scan reading `Blocked-by:` literally would keep #11838 parked while waiting on work that was never the dependency — and PR 2 is a 29-call-site sweep across blocking gates, so the wait is not short. This is not "the field is imprecise"; it is the field pointing at a condition that is **independent** of the real one.

The two conditions already on this card are "a PR merges" and "a release lands and the pin covers it". This is the first shape, with a rider the card does not yet state: when the PR carries `Part of` rather than a closing keyword, the tracking issue **cannot** close when the blocking PR lands, by construction. So for every `Part of` PR, naming the issue is guaranteed to over-wait, not merely likely to.

### What discharged it, verified by content rather than by the PR body

I unblocked and dispatched #11838 on this reading, so the evidence is on the record:

| reading | result |
|:---|:---|
| landing commit on objectui `main`, located by `(#6133)` in its subject | `0c25598 feat(tooling): gate scripts/ entry guards on one predicate (#6133)` |
| the ported shape is actually present — `interpolation` array in `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` | yes: `const interpolation = new Uint8Array(n)` at `:150`, brace-balancing at `:271-277` |
| **control** — `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS`, which #6133 states it deliberately did *not* port | **0** |

The control is what makes the two positive readings worth anything: it proves the grep discriminates rather than matching everything.

### The cheap half, if it is useful to whoever takes this

Both instances on this card and this one are all detectable the same way: the blocking comment's prose names the real condition while the machine field names something else. In all three the prose contains a PR reference (`#6133` here) that the `Blocked-by:` line does not. That is a mechanical signal — not a proposal, and I have not measured how often it would fire.

⚠️ Also worth noting against #11747's census: this card was **not** in the "waits on an already-closed upstream" bucket, because its upstream is genuinely still open. It is a fourth bucket — *waits on an upstream that is open for reasons unrelated to the dependency* — which a closed-upstream scan cannot find.

The canonical `Blocked-by:` marker work and H28–H31 additions changed how the one existing form is *read*; no PR-merge or release form entered the vocabulary, so both measured cases stand as filed.

Dispatch note under the current `pm:queue` grading, so the maintainer design call isn't usurped: **option 3 is the dispatchable half** — a protocol row stating the discipline (a card waiting on a merge or a release names an issue that closes at the right moment: the pin-bump chore card for the release case, per the live objectui#5601→#5716 precedent), zero mechanism. Options 1/2 (a `!PR` form; a release/lockfile form) stay a maintainer question and should be put to him only if the option-3 discipline measurably fails to hold — that failure evidence, not preference, is what would reprice mechanization.
